blurb.en: A market-reading Longbridge client made for Omarchy, following its system theme and keyboard conventions — and the reference for running a JavaScript application natively through GPUI Shell.
blurb.zh: 为 Omarchy 定制的 Longbridge 行情客户端，跟随其系统主题与键盘约定；同时也是用 GPUI Shell 让 JavaScript 应用以原生方式运行的参考实现。
